title: Bsd Saturation
objective: Implement honest genus-2/3 Mordell-Weil subgroup saturation and index certificates
references: Nils Bruin and Michael Stoll, The Mordell-Weil sieve: proving non-existence of rational points on curves
Samir Siksek, Infinite descent on elliptic curves

oracles: existing certified finite-field Jacobian invariant-factor maps
exact toy lattices with independently known saturation and index

handoff.summary: Adds an ordinary-Python, Wasm-safe saturation engine with exact finite-reduction constraints, bounded rational division/enlargement, basis/index chains, proved rank/index provenance, regulator/height index bounds, and structured unsupported/resource outcomes. The result separately labels independence, full rank, ambient S-saturation, free-quotient saturation, global index, torsion completion, and full Mordell-Weil determination.
risks: The default real-Jacobian reduction provider needs the integration lane's native-addon build for an end-to-end local run; its pure coordinate mathematics and provider boundary are covered here.
A failed bounded division candidate search is intentionally unresolved unless the provider supplies a certified exhaustive result.
Public Jacobian methods, strict-module registry entries, and forthcoming height/torsion adapters are integration-owned and intentionally not edited in this narrow lane.
next_steps: Wire HyperellipticJacobian.saturate lazily to saturate_subgroup and add saturation.py to pyrightconfig.json.
Run the default reduction provider against genus-2/3 rational fixtures with native addons available.
Connect certified height lower bounds and exact torsion-subgroup records through the documented duck-typed inputs.
